Your roof is one of the most important parts of your home. Even small issues can lead to leaks, structural damage, and expensive repairs if left untreated. Our roof repair services are designed to address problems early and extend the life of your roofing system.
We work with honesty and attention to detail, ensuring every repair is completed correctly and built to withstand Florida’s challenging climate.
Sifontes Roofing & Repair LLC offers a wide range of roof repair services tailored to your roof type and condition.

Roof Tile Repair Services 
 
 
  Tile roofs are common in Naples, Florida, but cracked or displaced tiles can allow water intrusion. We repair broken, loose, or missing tiles while preserving the integrity of the surrounding roofing system. Our repairs maintain both protection and curb appeal.

Skylight Repairs and Leak Prevention 
 
 
  Skylights add natural light, but improper sealing can cause leaks. We repair skylight flashing, seals, and surrounding materials to prevent water damage while keeping your skylight functional and secure.

Roof Chimney Repairs and Flashing 
 
 
  Chimneys are a frequent source of roof leaks due to deteriorated flashing or sealant. Our team inspects and repairs chimney flashing to ensure a watertight seal where the chimney meets the roof.

Carpentry Repairs for Roofing 
 
 
  Water damage can weaken roof decking and wooden components. We provide carpentry repairs related to roofing, including replacement of damaged wood, to restore the structural support your roof depends on.

Roofing Inspections and Evaluations 
 
 
  Not every roof problem is obvious. Our roofing inspections help identify hidden damage, aging materials, or areas at risk of future leaks. We provide clear evaluations and recommendations so homeowners can make informed decisions.
Our experience allows us to repair a wide variety of roofing systems commonly found in Southwest Florida homes.

Tile Roof Repairs 
 
 
  Tile roofing systems require specialized knowledge. We understand how tiles, underlayment, and fastening systems work together and perform repairs without causing unnecessary damage.

Metal Roof Repairs 
 
 
  Metal roofs are durable but can develop issues at seams, fasteners, and flashing points. We repair metal roofing systems to restore weather resistance and long-term performance.

Shingle Roof Repairs 
 
 
  Shingle roofs may suffer from wind damage, aging, or missing shingles. Our repairs address problem areas and help prevent leaks and further deterioration.

Flat and Low-Slope Roof Repairs 
 
 
  Flat roofs require proper drainage and sealing to avoid standing water. We inspect membranes, seams, and drainage systems to provide effective flat roof repairs.

Every roof repair begins with a thorough inspection. We assess the roof’s condition, identify problem areas, and explain our findings clearly. Our goal is to provide solutions that fit your roof’s needs and your budget.
